shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts && cat tsconfig.json && cat AGENTS.md'

/bin/bash -lc ".agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Switch ThemeProvider TextInput Select Modal Checkbox Progress TextArea && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && sed -n '1,165p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md && node -e \"for(const p of ['uikit','navigation','icons']) console.log(p,require('@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json').version)\""

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Switch ThemeProvider TextInput Select Modal Checkbox Progress TextArea && sed -n '1,125p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && sed -n '1,155p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -L -s --max-time 20 https://gravity-ui.com/icons -o /tmp/gravity-icons.html && rg -o '\"(House|LayoutCells|Folder|CircleCheck|Magnifier|Plus|ArrowRight|Sun|Moon|Bell|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|Ellipsis|Calendar|ArrowUpRight|Xmark|Check|CircleQuestion|ArrowUp|Clock|Flag|Gear|Bars|Persons|Link|Rocket|Star)[A-Za-z]*\"' /tmp/gravity-icons.html | sort -u && rg -n 'aside-header|AsideHeader' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md && sed -n '1,195p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/Logo/Logo.d.ts && node -e \"for(const p of ['uikit','navigation','icons']){const q=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('node_modules/@gravity-ui/'+p+'/package.json')); console.log(p,q.version,q.peerDependencies)}\""

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,190p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && rg -n -A 45 'interface LogoProps|interface MenuItem' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && rg -n -- '--gn-|--g-color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -50 && rg -n -- '--g-progress|--g-button|--g-text-input' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Progress/Progress.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.css | head -35 && rg -n 'House|Folder|LayoutCells|CircleCheck|Magnifier|Plus|ArrowRight|Sun|Moon|Bell|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|Ellipsis|Calendar|ArrowUpRight|Xmark|Check|CircleQuestion|Clock|Flag|Gear|Bars|Persons|Link|Rocket|Star' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,re
try:
 s=urllib.request.urlopen('https://gravity-ui.com/icons',timeout=15).read().decode()
 open('/tmp/gravity-icons.html','w').write(s)
 names=re.findall(r'\"(?:House|Folder|LayoutCells|CircleCheck|Magnifier|Plus|ArrowRight|Sun|Moon|Bell|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|Ellipsis|Calendar|ArrowUpRight|Xmark|Check|CircleQuestion|Clock|Flag|Gear|Bars|Persons|Link|Rocket|Star)[A-Za-z]*\"',s)
 print('\\n'.join(sorted(set(names))))
except Exception as e: print(e)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'const s=await (await fetch(\"https://gravity-ui.com/icons\")).text(); const names=s.match(/\"(?:House|Folder|LayoutCells|CircleCheck|Magnifier|Plus|ArrowRight|Sun|Moon|Bell|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|Ellipsis|Calendar|ArrowUpRight|Xmark|Check|CircleQuestion|Clock|Flag|Gear|Bars|Persons|Link|Rocket|Star)[A-Za-z]*\"/g)||[]; console.log([...new Set(names)].join(\"\\n\"))' && rg -n -A 55 '"'^## CSS|''^### CSS|--gn-aside-header'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | tail -65 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '535,580p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && rg -n 'export.*(House|Folder|LayoutCells|CircleCheck|Magnifier|Plus|ArrowRight|Sun|Moon|Bell|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|Ellipsis|Calendar|ArrowUpRight|Xmark|CircleQuestion|Clock|Flag|Bars|Persons|Rocket|Sparkles|SquareListUl)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && rg -n -A 18 'interface ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,60p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && git status --short && node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from \"node:fs\";const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(\"package.json\",\"utf8\")); console.log(\"Dependencies:\",JSON.stringify(pkg.dependencies));const css=fs.readFileSync(\"node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css\",\"utf8\");console.log(\"Navigation geometry:\",css.slice(0,800));const s=fs.readFileSync(\"src/styles.css\",\"utf8\");console.log(\"Theme blocks:\",[...s.matchAll(/g-root_theme_([a-z]+)/g)].map(x=>x[1]).join(\", \"));console.log(\"Responsive breakpoints:\",[...s.matchAll(/@media\\((max|min)-width:(\\d+)px\\)/g)].map(x=>x[1]+\":\"+x[2]).join(\", \"));'"
